CofactorMech.scope: Site-only Chrome/Playwright review on November 19, 2026 America/Los_Angeles; receipt timestamps are UTC. All 24 criteria were judged from current page content and reader actions, with identifier/label and empty searches, filters/reset, URL reload, theme persistence, fresh and resized 390px layouts, representative populated details and failed-request recovery where applicable. Complete inventories or published manifests support catalogue coverage. Successful deployment and served Last-Modified were checked before and after. Corpus census pins are unchanged. These auditor proposals require independent skeptical review.

search.note: The labelled catalogue search finds both CofactorMech:biotin and biotin, each showing one of 14 records with a working record link. Unmatched and literal-markup queries show zero matches.

facets.note: The Category selector filters the complete listing; Coenzyme shows six records. Keyboard activation of Reset filters restores all 14 and returns focus to the search field.

result_counts.note: Showing N of 14 records responds to search, category filtering and reset; the empty state retains the total and explains how to recover.

sorting.note: The listing uses a fixed name order and exposes no sort selector or sortable column headings.

shareable_state.note: An explicitly supplied ?q=biotin URL restores the search, but changing the search or category in the interface does not update the URL; reloading the ordinary search loses its state.

full_catalogue.note: All 14 records counted by the manifest have catalogue links and served record pages. The complete 14-record table remains visible with JavaScript disabled.

record_pages.note: Every catalogue record has a stable records/<slug>/index.html page; all 14 pages rendered populated identity, relationship, gap and provenance sections.

term_links.note: Chemical evidence links its ChEBI source, but the primary chemical CURIE and related target CURIEs are plain text. Biotin's related CHEBI:57586 has neither a resolver link nor a readable chemical label in its target field.

evidence.note: All record pages render their recorded evidence URLs as Source reference links beside the claim and source locator. Biotin links its chemical identity and each scoped relationship's supporting source.

review_status.note: PROVISIONAL and VERIFIED badges describe individual relationships. Record pages do not state a whole-record curation or review status.

curation_history.note: Each record's Curation provenance table shows its recorded timestamp, action, curator and change summary, with a link to the history source.

source_link.note: Each record links its own YAML on GitHub at the displayed repository revision and offers the same source YAML as a site download; the public source-file hashes match the manifest.

domain_view.note: The published catalogue and record pages provide text and tables; no chemical structure, embedding map or relationship diagram is offered.

cross_mech_links.note: Scoped relationships link specific source records in sibling repositories at recorded revisions. Biotin links MediaIngredientMech, ProteinTraitsMech and PathwayMech records while retaining provisional and conjugate-form distinctions.

corpus_stats.note: The generated landing page shows 14 records and category counts of six coenzymes, five metal ions and three prosthetic groups, matching its corpus manifest.

category_browse.note: Category counts appear as static tiles and the catalogue has a working category filter, but no linked category pages or category index routes are published.

suite_nav.note: The visible All Mech projects navigation link leads to the maintained X-Mech Suite directory from the catalogue and every record page.

downloads.note: Every record offers its YAML and the footer links a corpus manifest, but the site does not link a bulk export containing all record content.

schema_docs.note: The footer links the raw LinkML YAML schema. No rendered schema documentation or class/slot browsing page is published in this site artifact.

license.note: Catalogue and record footers state CC-BY-4.0 for curated records and CC0 for original code and schemas, link the licence notice, and retain upstream attribution. These agree with the repository LICENSE.

build_provenance.note: Every page states the repository revision and corpus/schema SHA-256 stamps; the linked corpus manifest records the same deployed revision and per-file hashes.

theme_toggle.note: No theme toggle is offered. Emulating a dark operating-system preference leaves the same light page background.

responsive.note: The catalogue and all 14 record pages have no document overflow at 390 pixels. Wide catalogue and history tables stay inside labelled, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions.

load_failure.note: The catalogue and record content are server-rendered HTML. No fetch or XHR data requests occurred across the 15 pages; blocking those request types left search functional, and all records remain accessible without JavaScript.

corpus_stats.note: The landing page shows nine records: six ontology assay concepts and three operational assays. Its category counts are six microbial-characterization records and one each for bioaccumulation, bioprocessing and biotransformation, matching the manifest.

search.note: AIMech:KernelPCA returns one linked concept, Adam returns 131 matches and SoftDTW returns one across the 1,930-record catalogue. Literal-markup and unmatched queries return zero.

facets.note: Origin, concept kind and AIO branch filters have Reset. Curated selects 1,488 records, algorithm selects 1,047 and Layer selects 168. Combining attention, Curated and architecture selects 48; Reset restores 1,930.

result_counts.note: The matching count changes to one for AIMech:KernelPCA, 131 for Adam and zero for an unmatched query, separately from the 1,930 total.

sorting.note: The browser offers six sort choices. Exercised name ascending, name descending and identifier ascending choices update the selected ordering and result rows.

shareable_state.note: Search, origin, kind, branch and sort controls encode their state in the URL. A cold load of the combined attention, Curated and architecture query restores the controls and 48 matches.

full_catalogue.note: The complete browser and downloaded index contain 1,930 records, matching 1,930 canonical YAML records and 1,930 static record pages in the untruncated deployed-revision inventory. Sampled links open populated records.

record_pages.note: Browse links static curated/<name>.html and aio/<name>.html record pages. Sampled Adam, KernelPCA, SoftDTW and TrainingStrategy pages render populated records.

term_links.note: Sampled accepted AIO mappings show names with linked CURIEs; AIO class pages link their ontology IRIs and labeled parent terms.

evidence.note: Sampled curated claims link source rows and primary evidence URLs; the landing distinguishes 5,151 claims from 3,271 evidence citations.

review_status.note: Sampled curated and imported class records show their workflow state in the record header.

curation_history.note: Curated pages show curator, method/model and created/updated times, but do not present an event-by-event change list; AIO pages give import provenance.

source_link.note: Sampled records link their individual data/curated or data/aio YAML file on GitHub.

domain_view.note: The graph renders 1,950 nodes and 4,258 edges; the text map contains 1,259 concepts, a subset of the 1,930-record catalogue. KernelPCA and unmatched queries exercise both maps, with reset restoring their respective totals.

cross_mech_links.note: Sampled record pages provide sibling navigation/search links rather than links to specific sibling-Mech records.

corpus_stats.note: The landing reports 1,930 concepts (1,488 curated and 442 AIO), 5,151 curated claims and 3,271 evidence citations.

category_browse.note: The landing links curated-kind and AIO-branch subsets with counts; the browser also provides working kind and branch filters.

suite_nav.note: Visible All Mech projects links connect the reviewed landing, browser, records and visualizations to the central suite directory.

downloads.note: Linked index.json contains all 1,930 concepts as listing metadata with claim/source counts; it omits complete claims and evidence. The downloaded corpus_map.json contains 1,259 map points. Per-record YAML sources are also linked.

schema_docs.note: The reviewed site links LinkML YAML source files. The previously recorded pages/schema.html documentation URL returns 404.

license.note: Footers display CC BY 4.0 / BSD-3-Clause data and BSD-3-Clause code, but do not clearly explain which data receives each license.

build_provenance.note: Page footers identify the project snapshot date 2026-11-16 and digest 62a5ad9f4862, separately from upstream AIO import provenance.

theme_toggle.note: Dark selected on the landing persists through Browse, sampled records, and both graph and text-map views.

responsive.note: Reviewed landing, Browse, visualizations and sampled curated records fit a 390px viewport, but the sampled imported AIO record TrainingStrategy.html widens the document to 412px on fresh and resized loads.

load_failure.note: Reviewed listings, records and visualizations embed their record data; no fetch or XHR data request was observed to abort.

search.note: Browse searches all 1,130 records: METPO:1004002 and traitmech:000616 each return one linked record; bipolar mating system returns two.

facets.note: Browse provides Category and Kind selectors plus Clear filters. Combining pathogen, ECOLOGY and CLASS gives eight records; reset restores all 1,130.

result_counts.note: The count responds to search and property filters: identifiers give 1 of 1,130 records shown; pathogen plus ECOLOGY and CLASS gives 8 of 1,130.

sorting.note: Browse offers label, identifier, category, kind, kg-microbe node-count and synonym-count ordering. Reversing label order changes the first row from 2,3-butanediol fermentation to Zorya type III system.

shareable_state.note: Search, category and kind are written to the URL. Reloading ?q=pathogen&category=ECOLOGY&kind=CLASS restores the controls and eight matches.

full_catalogue.note: Browse exposes 1,130 distinct record links, matching the landing, bulk export and all 1,130 canonical records and record HTML paths in the untruncated deployed-revision inventory.

record_pages.note: All 1,130 traits have static pages under pages/traits/<category>/<slug>.html. Sampled animal pathogen, aerobic respiration and Wood–Ljungdahl pages show populated overview, grounding, curation and source sections.

term_links.note: Record identifiers have readable labels and resolver links. Aerobic respiration links GO:0009060 in Cross-references, but that whole section still lacks a readable term label.

evidence.note: Animal pathogen and aerobic respiration link their trait and causal-edge DOI citations and display supporting text.

review_status.note: Sampled record headers and Identifier cards show the record workflow status, including REVIEWED on animal pathogen. This is distinct from a claim that all records were manually reviewed.

curation_history.note: Sampled record pages display dated curation events, attributed curators and change summaries.

source_link.note: Record Source cards link View YAML on GitHub, Raw YAML and Edit on GitHub for the record’s own data/traits YAML.

domain_view.note: Sampled record pages render causal SVG diagrams. PaCMAP, text and graph-layout maps each render 1,130 traits, and the sequence map renders 156 associated proteins; these are separately labeled views.

cross_mech_links.note: Wood–Ljungdahl’s Pathway context links to PathwayMech WikiPathways:WP5019. The target returns HTTP 200; the trait page retains organism scope and the target revision.

corpus_stats.note: The landing page shows 1,130 trait records, 10 categories and 100.0% embedding coverage. Reviewed and causal-graph totals are corpus-source statistics, not landing tiles.

category_browse.note: Browse links ten category pages with counts; the opened ECOLOGY page contains 40 records and QUANTITATIVE_PROPERTY contains seven.

suite_nav.note: All Mech projects links the landing, Browse, sampled categories and records, all four maps and the discussions index to the suite directory.

downloads.note: Download traits.json provides 1,130 full records, including definitions, evidence, causal graphs and curation history. Downloaded map exports contain 1,130 traits or 156 proteins as labeled.

schema_docs.note: Visible Schema and LinkML schema links open the annotated LinkML YAML source successfully. They provide source access; the reviewed navigation does not link rendered schema documentation or the explanatory schema guide.

license.note: Templated landing, Browse, record and map pages state CC BY 4.0 project data and BSD-3-Clause code, with third-party terms retained. The linked discussions index omits these licence notices and links.

build_provenance.note: Landing, Browse and map footers give a dated version of the project corpus, alongside the METPO baseline and record count.

theme_toggle.note: Selecting dark on the landing persists through Browse, two categories, three records, all four maps and the discussions index in the same browser context.

responsive.note: At 390px, the text and sequence maps overflow: 553px document width on fresh load and 793px after resizing from 1280px. The other ten sampled routes, including PaCMAP and graph layout, fit 390px.

load_failure.note: Aborted JSON requests produce explicit map failure messages and Retry; retry after restoring requests recovers 1,130 traits or 156 proteins. Aborting discussion data shows Discussions could not be loaded; reload after restoring requests recovers 925 discussions.
